# Imperial Finishing Ltd

> Imperial Finishing Ltd is a custom finishing carpentry business in Calgary, Alberta, that also works in Lake Country, British Columbia. It is owned and run by Mike Robertson, a journeyman finishing carpenter. Established 2003.

## Services
- [Kitchen cabinetry](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): cabinet installation set level, square and scribed to walls and ceilings.
- [Trim and baseboards](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): baseboards, casing and crown moulding with tight mitres and coped corners.
- [Doors and hardware](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): interior doors, casing, closet doors and hardware.
- [Built-ins and millwork](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): shelving, benches, mudroom lockers, entertainment walls and pantry storage.
- [Stairs and railings](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): treads, risers, skirt boards, newel posts and railings.
- [Wainscoting and feature walls](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): wainscoting, board and batten, and panel moulding.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/): 3D room showing each stage of finishing work, services, kitchen project details, trim style profiles, a trim estimator, service area, FAQ and the quote form
